title: Joomla Customize with a name and a description: no declared demo company name stays on the site, blog posts and keep slots included (JA Boxing 1.0.3: Studio Getfit, Systems Training Center, JA Boxing masthead)
steps: S1: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs with the name pattern 'JA Boxing, About and a name' (real JA Boxing j6 1.0.3 contract, About and Name given, a model double that echoes the demo words, prepare + apply through the site double)
S2: the same file, pattern 'a description given renames the demo company too' (Tracy Business with a copy file: About given renames, a name from the address or no names declared renames nothing)
expect: S1: no text slot of the JA Boxing content map that a visitor reads holds 'Studio Getfit', 'Getfit studio', 'JA Boxing' or 'Systems Training Center' after the writes, keep slots module-162.0/.1 and menuItem-101.1/.2 included
S2: module-674.3 is written '{site.name} wins the {site.name} 2 infrastructure tender' with About given; nothing is written there for nameFrom label or without declared names

selectors.engine: brief-engines/joomla.js demoNameChanges block, prepared.renamedKeep, apply keepRenamed

fence: A name the customer gave replaces every declared demo company name, whatever About holds

cmd: --test-name-pattern=JA Boxing, About and a name|a description given renames the demo company too
tests: JA Boxing, About and a name given
a description given renames the demo company too
